test_WoLFPHC_pathfinding: test the WoLFPHC algorithm on a pathfinding environment with two players and verify convergence within 500 steps
test_WoLFPHC_rps_strategy: test WoLFPHC learners playing rock-paper-scissors and verify they converge to uniform 1/3 probability distribution
test_WoLFPHC_vs_QLearner: test WoLFPHC learner against a standard QLearner in a multi-agent pathfinding environment
test_WoLFPHC_convergence: test WoLFPHC convergence by running 1000 episodes of matrix_rps and checking strategy probabilities
test_WoLFPHC_multi_agent: test multiple WoLFPHC agents interacting in a two-player game environment with step-based reward structure
